    # A color-4 row separates two aligned binary layers. Mark the union
    # of the nonzero cells in the upper and lower layers with color 3.
    separator = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(value == 4 for value in row))
    upper = grid[:separator]
    lower = grid[separator + 1:]
    return [
        [3 if upper[r][c] != 0 or lower[r][c] != 0 else 0
         for c in range(len(upper[r]))]
        for r in range(len(upper))
    ]
